verdict.rationale: First-party documentation includes a 'Navigate the interface using the keyboard' topic (ubuntu-docs-46), but it is only a title, framed under accessibility. Community reports show some keyboard workflows: a type-to-launch Dash (ubuntu-comm-16), the Unity HUD for menu search (ubuntu-comm-6), and Win+Shift+arrow window moves (ubuntu-comm-12). However, the Dash and HUD evidence comes from the discontinued Unity era, and one user notes keybindings need tweaking (ubuntu-comm-14). Missing for 10: documented full-system hotkey coverage for the current desktop, documentation of the current app launcher, custom shortcut configuration, and hands-on evidence that the entire system is operable keyboard-only.
